pkgmetadata.longdescription: Claude Desktop is the official desktop application for Claude, an AI assistant by Anthropic. This binary package repackages the official Linux build maintained by the upstream community project claude-desktop-extra (formerly claude-desktop-bin), which adds Computer Use backends, custom themes, multi-profile support and Quick Entry on top of the official build.

use.flag: Pull in app-emulation/qemu and app-emulation/virtiofsd so Claude Desktop's Cowork feature can boot its sandbox microVM

Add residual Computer Use fallbacks for Wayland sessions without a bundled bridge: x11-misc/ydotool for exotic compositors (requires ydotoold daemon running) and media-gfx/imagemagick for KDE below Plasma 6.6
